complaints.name: Negative - Poor Service Quality
complaints.text: I am extremely disappointed with the service I received. The staff was rude and unhelpful. I waited over an hour for assistance and when I finally got help, they couldn't resolve my issue. The product I received was damaged and not as described. This is unacceptable and I demand a full refund immediately.

complaints.name: Negative - Billing Issue
complaints.text: I have been charged incorrectly for the past three months. Despite multiple calls to customer service, no one has been able to fix this billing error. I am frustrated with the lack of resolution and the time I've wasted trying to get this sorted out. Please credit my account immediately.

complaints.name: Negative - Delivery Problem
complaints.text: My order was supposed to arrive last week but it still hasn't shown up. The tracking information hasn't been updated in days. I've tried contacting support multiple times but keep getting automated responses. This is completely unacceptable for a paid service.

complaints.name: Positive - Great Experience
complaints.text: I wanted to express my gratitude for the excellent service I received. The staff went above and beyond to help me with my request. The product quality exceeded my expectations and the delivery was prompt. I will definitely be using your services again and recommending you to friends.

complaints.name: Positive - Problem Resolved
complaints.text: Thank you for quickly resolving the issue I reported last week. Your customer service team was professional, courteous, and efficient. The replacement product arrived quickly and works perfectly. I appreciate your commitment to customer satisfaction.

complaints.name: Neutral - Information Request
complaints.text: I am writing to inquire about the return policy for items purchased online. Can you please provide information about the time frame for returns and any restocking fees that may apply? I would also like to know the process for initiating a return.

complaints.name: Neutral - Product Question
complaints.text: I am interested in purchasing your product but have a few questions before making a decision. What are the dimensions of the item? Does it come with a warranty? What is the estimated shipping time to my location? Please provide this information at your earliest convenience.

complaints.name: Negative - Technical Issue
complaints.text: The software I purchased is constantly crashing and losing my work. I've followed all the troubleshooting steps provided but the problem persists. This is causing significant disruption to my business operations. I need immediate technical support or a refund.

complaints.name: Negative - Mixed Feelings
complaints.text: While I appreciate the quality of the product itself, I am very disappointed with the customer service experience. The product arrived late and when I called to inquire, I was put on hold for 45 minutes. The product works well but the overall experience was poor.

complaints.name: Positive - Exceptional Service
complaints.text: I am writing to commend your team for the outstanding service I received. Not only was the product exactly as described, but when I had a question, your support team responded within minutes and provided clear, helpful guidance. This level of service is rare and greatly appreciated.

complaints.name: Neutral - Account Inquiry
complaints.text: I need to update my account information including my email address and phone number. Can you please guide me through the process or provide a link to where I can make these changes? I also want to confirm that my payment method on file is still valid.

complaints.name: Negative - Cancellation Issue
complaints.text: I cancelled my subscription over a month ago but I'm still being charged. I've sent multiple emails and made several phone calls but the charges continue. This is unauthorized billing and I want it stopped immediately. I also want a refund for all charges after my cancellation date.

complaints.name: Positive - Exceeded Expectations
complaints.text: I am thrilled with my purchase! The product arrived earlier than expected, was beautifully packaged, and works even better than advertised. The customer service representative I spoke with was knowledgeable and friendly. This has been one of my best online shopping experiences.

complaints.name: Neutral - Feedback Submission
complaints.text: I would like to provide feedback on my recent experience. The ordering process was straightforward and the website was easy to navigate. I received email confirmations at each step. Overall, the process was smooth, though I think the checkout could be simplified slightly.

complaints.name: Negative - Product Defect
complaints.text: The item I received is defective and doesn't work at all. I've tried everything to get it functioning but it appears to be a manufacturing defect. I need a replacement or refund as soon as possible. This is very inconvenient as I needed this item for an important project.

complaints.name: Negative - Late Delivery (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: I paid for guaranteed Tuesday delivery. My order was supposed to arrive yesterday but it still hasn't shown up. The delivery was delayed and I'm very frustrated. This was supposed to be a gift for someone special.

complaints.name: Negative - Tracking Stalled (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: I paid for guaranteed Tuesday delivery. Tracking has been 'Pending' for 3 days with no scans. Nobody notified me. This was a gift. The tracking information hasn't moved in days and there are no updates.

complaints.name: Negative - Damaged Package (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: The box arrived completely crushed and the almonds inside were spilled everywhere. The package was damaged during shipping and the container was broken. Some items were lost due to the damage.

complaints.name: Negative - Delivered Not Received (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: The tracking says delivered but I did not receive the package. It says delivered but not received at my address. I checked with neighbors and the package is nowhere to be found.

complaints.name: Negative - Missing Items (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: My order was incomplete. I ordered 5 items but only received 3. The missing items were the chocolate covered almonds and the cashews. The order was incomplete and I'm missing half of what I paid for.

complaints.name: Negative - Wrong Item (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: I ordered salted pistachios but received unsalted ones instead. This is not what I ordered. The product is different from what I selected. I need the correct item or a refund.

complaints.name: Negative - Poor Product Quality (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: The quality of the nuts I received is terrible. The quality is poor and not what I expected. I'm very disappointed with the quality. The nuts are not good quality at all.

complaints.name: Negative - Stale Product (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: The cashews I received are stale and not fresh. They taste stale and have a soft texture. The product is old and definitely not fresh. I expected fresh nuts but got stale ones instead.

complaints.name: Negative - Expired Product (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: The chocolate I received is expired! The expiration date passed last month. The product is past expiration date and should not have been sent. This is a serious issue - expired food products.

complaints.name: Negative - Rancid Product (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: The walnuts I received taste rancid and have an off flavor. The taste is completely off and the nuts are rancid. This is inedible and has a bad taste. I cannot eat these.

complaints.name: Negative - Melted Chocolate (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: The chocolate covered pretzels arrived completely melted. The chocolate was melted and mushy when I opened the package. It was damaged by heat during shipping. The package was warm when it arrived.

complaints.name: Negative - Allergen Concern (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: I have a severe peanut allergy and ordered products that should be peanut-free. However, I'm concerned about cross-contamination and allergen safety. The packaging doesn't clearly state if it's processed in a facility with peanuts. This is an allergen concern.

complaints.name: Negative - Contamination (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: I found a foreign object in my bag of almonds. There was a piece of plastic and what looks like a hair inside the package. The product appears to be contaminated. I found something in the product that shouldn't be there.

complaints.name: Negative - Wrong Address (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: My package was delivered to the wrong address. The tracking shows it was delivered but to a completely different location. It was misdelivered to the wrong address. I never received it because it went to the wrong place.

complaints.name: Negative - Poor Customer Service (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: I've tried contacting customer service multiple times but received no response. The service is terrible and unhelpful. When I finally got through, the representative was rude and unresponsive. This is poor customer service.

complaints.name: Negative - Billing Error (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: I was overcharged for my order. The price on the website was $29.99 but I was charged $39.99. This is a billing error and I was charged incorrectly. I need a refund for the difference.

complaints.name: Negative - Multiple Issues (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: My order arrived late, the box was damaged, and the chocolate was melted. The package was crushed, items were missing, and the product quality was poor. This is completely unacceptable.

complaints.name: Negative - Very Negative with Critical Terms (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: This is completely unsafe and inedible. The product was ruined and I demand a refund immediately. Never again will I order from you. This is a chargeback situation. The food was contaminated and made me sick.

complaints.name: Negative - Expired and Contaminated (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: The dried fruit I received was expired and I found mold on some pieces. The expiration date passed weeks ago and the product is contaminated. This is unsafe to eat and completely inedible.

complaints.name: Negative - Allergen Reaction (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: I had an allergic reaction after eating your product. The packaging didn't clearly list all ingredients and I'm concerned about allergen safety. This is a serious allergen concern and could have been much worse.

complaints.name: Negative - High Severity Multiple Issues (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: The product was expired, tasted rancid, and I found a foreign object inside. This is completely unsafe, inedible, and contaminated. I demand a full refund and will never order again. This is unacceptable for food products.

complaints.name: Negative - Temperature Damage Multiple Items (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: My entire order arrived warm and the chocolate items were completely melted. The chocolate covered almonds, pretzels, and fudge were all damaged by heat. The package was left in direct sunlight and everything melted.

complaints.name: Negative - Wrong Items Multiple (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: I ordered 3 different items but received completely wrong products. I got salted instead of unsalted, milk chocolate instead of dark, and the wrong size. None of the items match what I ordered.

complaints.name: Negative - Tracking No Updates Extended (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: My tracking hasn't moved in 7 days. There have been no scans and no updates for over a week. The package seems stuck in transit with no tracking information. I have no idea where my order is.

complaints.name: Negative - Delivered Not Received Complex (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: The tracking says my package was delivered yesterday but I did not receive it. I checked with neighbors, my mailbox, and front door. It says delivered but not received. This was an expensive gift order.

complaints.name: Negative - Stale Multiple Products (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: All the nuts I received are stale - the almonds, cashews, and walnuts all taste old and not fresh. The products are stale and have been sitting for too long. Nothing is fresh in my order.

complaints.name: Negative - Quality and Service Combined (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: The product quality is poor and when I tried to contact customer service, they were unhelpful and rude. The nuts are stale, the service is terrible, and I'm very disappointed with this experience.

complaints.name: Negative - Billing and Delivery Issues (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: I was charged the wrong price and my order arrived late. The billing error shows I was overcharged, and the delivery was delayed by 5 days. This is frustrating on multiple levels.

complaints.name: Negative - Missing Items and Wrong Address (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: My order was incomplete with missing items, and it was also delivered to the wrong address initially. I'm missing 2 items from my order and had to wait extra time because of the misdelivery.

complaints.name: Negative - Product Quality and Expiration (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: The product quality is terrible and some items are expired. The nuts are stale, the quality is poor, and the chocolate has passed its expiration date. This is completely unacceptable.

complaints.name: Negative - Rancid and Contamination (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: The nuts taste rancid and I found a foreign object in the package. The product has an off taste and appears to be contaminated. This is unsafe and inedible.

complaints.name: Negative - Allergen and Wrong Item (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: I received the wrong product and I'm concerned about allergen safety. The item I got contains ingredients I'm allergic to, and it's not what I ordered. This is a serious allergen concern.

complaints.name: Negative - Temperature Damage and Late Delivery (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: My order arrived late and the chocolate was completely melted. The delivery was delayed and the product was damaged by heat. Everything arrived warm and the chocolate items are ruined.

complaints.name: Negative - Customer Service Unresponsive (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: I've sent multiple emails and called several times but customer service is completely unresponsive. No one has responded to my inquiries. The service is terrible and I feel ignored.

complaints.name: Negative - Complex Multi-Issue Complaint (Nuts.com)
complaints.text: My order was supposed to arrive last Tuesday but tracking shows it was delivered to the wrong address. When I finally got it, the box was crushed, items were missing, the chocolate was melted, and the nuts were stale. The product quality is poor, customer service is unhelpful, and I was overcharged. This is completely unacceptable.
